operations.name: Donald Hoffman

expected.charges: Conscientious refusal of military service; individual statutory count unverified
expected.sentence: Listed in actual federal custody at Allenwood in the December 1965 Catholic Worker and in the year-end 1965 Azione nonviolenta War Resisters International list of imprisoned conscientious objectors. The international list describes an extended holiday-period imprisonment context. Individual sentence length, exact admission and release dates, and total actual time served remain unverified.
